description: Look up a company in an official public EU business register in one call, any of the 27 EU states. Live open registers by ID or name: EE (with board members), FR (with directors), CZ, FI, PL (KRS number or NIP), LV, IE, HR (Sudski registar: OIB, MBS or full/partial name; no officers in the public API); DK (CVR via Datafordeler: CVR number or full registered name; no persons); AT (Firmenbuch via JustizOnline: FN such as 93363 z or a name; officers with representation rules, no birth dates); NL (KVK open dataset, free: basic data of BV and NV by KVK number only, no names or persons; names return the kvk.nl search link plus GLEIF LEI holders); LT, SE and SI from nightly snapshots of the official open bulk files (data_as_of in the answer). Other states return the official register lookup URL plus matching LEI holders from GLEIF. Any EU VAT number is checked live in VIES (id_type=vat or a prefixed number like DE123456789); LEIs via id_type=lei or country=EU. Every answer has source_url, licence and retrieved_at. Free, read-only.

country.description: EU member state code (EE, FR, DE, ...; EL or GR for Greece), or EU for an LEI search.

id_type.description: Optional. vat = VIES check, lei = GLEIF. Default: detected from the query.

query.description: Registry code (EE 8 digits, FR SIREN, CZ IČO, FI Y-tunnus, PL KRS or NIP, LV 11 digits, LT 9 digits, SE organisationsnummer 10 digits, SI matična številka 7 or 10 digits, IE company number, HR OIB 11 digits or MBS, DK CVR 8 digits, NL KVK number 8 digits, AT Firmenbuchnummer e.g. FN 93363 z), VAT number, LEI or company name.

name: get_company
